name: Boston Bruins
linesAsOf: Nov 8 vs FLA game lineup, per NHL.com 'Need to Know: Bruins vs. Panthers' (Sturm's game-day lineup); no projection yet for Nov 12 vs MTL

players.how: Signed as a free agent in 2025.
players.story: Recalled from Providence, where he led the AHL with 13 goals in eight games. Scored in the first period of his season debut against Florida on Nov. 8, on the line with Minten and Geekie.

players.how: Signed as a free agent from Seattle in 2023; re-signed long term in 2025.
players.story: A depth forward in Carolina and Seattle who became a goal scorer in Boston, with a team-high 39 goals last season. Scored on a 5-on-3 power play against Florida on Nov. 8.

players.how: Drafted 7th overall in 2025 out of Boston College.
players.story: Placed on IR on Nov. 7 with a lower-body injury after a cross-check from Samuel Girard on Nov. 5. Sturm said it will be a few weeks.

players.how: Signed as a free agent in 2025 after a season in Los Angeles.
players.story: Undrafted power forward from Saskatchewan. Brings hits and fights more than points (22 last season).

players.how: Came from Ottawa with Joonas Korpisalo in the 2024 Linus Ullmark trade.
players.story: A 6'4" energy player who hits and fights. Took down Garnet Hathaway in a fight against Florida on Nov. 8.

players.how: Traded from Minnesota for Justin Brazeau in March 2025.
players.story: Fast Russian forward who signed a three-year, $3.95M-a-year extension on Oct. 21. Moved to the right side of the Mittelstadt-Lindholm line at Saturday's practice in place of Hagens.

contract.note: Three-year extension at $3.95M AAV starts in 2027-28.

players.how: Returned as a free agent in 2025 after four seasons in Columbus.
players.story: Sat out the Nov. 8 win over Florida as Poitras returned to centre the fourth line.

players.how: Signed a seven-year deal as a free agent in 2024.
players.story: A two-way Swedish centre who starred in Calgary. Opened the scoring against Florida on Nov. 8 with a point shot that stood after video review.

players.how: Came from Toronto in the March 2025 Brandon Carlo trade.
players.story: Played all 82 games last season with 17 goals. Scored the power-play winner and had an assist against San Jose on Oct. 24, earning first star.

contract.note: Entry-level deal this season; his extension starts in 2027-28.

players.how: Traded from Colorado for Charlie Coyle at the 2025 deadline.
players.story: Former 8th overall pick from Minnesota. Scored his fifth goal and fought Alex Vlasic in the win over Chicago.

players.how: Drafted 25th overall in 2014.
players.story: The franchise scorer and, since September, the 28th captain in team history. Had two assists in the 4-1 win over Florida on Nov. 8.

players.how: Traded from Utah on June 26, 2026, for Boston’s 2026 first-round pick and a conditional 2028 first.
players.story: The headline summer move, traded from Utah in June. Scored early in the third period against Florida on Nov. 8 on a set-up from Pastrnak.

players.how: Drafted 54th overall in 2022.
players.story: Returned from a broken nose on Nov. 8 and centred Jeannot and Kastelic in the win over Florida.

players.how: Traded from New Jersey for Erik Haula in 2022.
players.story: Former 6th overall pick who had career highs of 30 goals and 65 points last season. Had two assists against Florida on Nov. 8 to extend his point streak.

players.how: Signed as an undrafted free agent after AHL seasons with Belleville and Calgary.
players.story: Healthy scratch again on Nov. 8 against Florida.

players.how: Traded from the Rangers on July 1, 2026, for a 2027 second and a conditional 2028 third.
players.story: A defensive defenceman added to steady the back end. Played in Buffalo, Seattle and New York.

players.how: Drafted 132nd overall in 2022.
players.story: Returned after three straight healthy scratches for the Nov. 5 game at Pittsburgh and assisted on Mark Kastelic's goal.

players.how: Signed a two-year deal on July 1, 2026, returning to Boston.
players.story: Healthy scratch again on Nov. 8 against Florida.

players.how: Traded from Anaheim at the 2022 deadline, then signed an eight-year extension.
players.story: Steady Swedish defenceman who plays heavy minutes against top lines. 26 points last season.

players.how: Drafted 58th overall in 2020 out of the USHL.
players.story: Big, mobile offensive defenceman from Ohio State. Scored his third goal to start the third-period comeback against Chicago.

players.how: Drafted 14th overall in 2016.
players.story: The No. 1 defenceman. Career-best 61 points last season. Missed the first six games through suspension; four assists vs. Nashville gives him six points in five games back.

players.how: Signed a six-year deal as a free agent in 2024.
players.story: The biggest player on the team at 6'7". Fought Brady Tkachuk right after the opening faceoff against Florida on Nov. 8.

players.how: Traded from Vancouver for Jack Studnicka in 2022.
players.story: Former Windsor Spitfires star who spent years in the AHL. Made 16 saves in the 6-2 win at Pittsburgh on Nov. 5 for his fourth straight win; he is 4-1-0.

players.how: Drafted 111th overall in 2017 out of the University of Maine.
players.story: Made 40 saves in the 4-1 win over Florida on Nov. 8, the Bruins' fourth straight win.
